_about: H-fever, the room (D15f, decision 27; the 1 Oct report §8H; js/clinic/heal/games/fever.js). Played in the wide exam room (CB2b), no close-up. A live wall thermometer with a green zone; things round the room cool or warm the patient by their size (things.*.size, in reading units; the zone and the level ladder are fever.js's K: room.rules overrides them). The patient's fever swings hot and cold; the doctor names the thing to use (levels 1-3, decision 91), from level 4 the last exchange is 'fix it' (decision 97 (8), CLN-45: L3 is L2 heard only). Every swing is sized so the named thing lands in the zone and at least one other thing a non-speaker could pick does too, so the thermometer never gives the answer away (C10). Every word is an English placeholder (data/clinic/lang.json fever-*), to record.

camera._about: D15f: the fever room plays in the wide shot itself (no zoom to a close-up). 'room' asks the heal host to skip the zoom (proposal in build/reports/archive/heal-C.md); until it does, the game removes the zoom layer itself.

room._about: things: side (cool/warm), size (S02-C, FV9, CLN-105: one number model, each thing adds or takes 2 small, 3 medium, 4 big), fixed (stays where it is: a toggle) or not (goes to the patient). at: where each sits on CB2b, in fractions of the picture (x centre, y its bottom, h and w its size), moved into view when a screen crops the picture (the art plan §3.4 positions; remeasure when the art lands).

window._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R4's open window, registered on the painted one (heal-art.json rooms.window-open): it stays exactly there (hang)

ceiling-fan._s08b: s08-w5b (CLN-105, the s08b FN1 fan: seen from in front and a little below): one picture, fan-still off and fan-spin on (art ceiling-fan-off/-on), 640x253; w is its width, art its whole height (w x 1.5 / 2.53), its ceiling plate at the picture's top edge; the button (h) is the motor and blades

heater._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R1's heater on the open floor in front of the bed's left leg, clear of the toys and the rug (it stood on them at x 0.215)
heater._s03: S03-C (FV5, CLN-105): on the floor to the right of the bed, turned to face her (flip), clear of the toys and the door (tablets clamp it into view)

blanket._s08b: s08-w5b (CLN-105; Zafar 18 Oct: 'put them on the bed with her ... one or two to the left, one or two to the right, lying on the bed ... resting on a solid surface'): the s08b FV1 things lying on the exam bed's top beside her, y = where each touches the bed, w its width; h follows the picture's shape (bed: true), a soft contact shadow under it

gauge._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R5 on the wall at x 0.76-0.84, y 0.12-0.40 (art plan 3.4), at the picture's own shape

art._about: The art swaps in by file name (docs/design-language/art-plans/clinic-heal-art-plan.md §8, R1, R2, R4, R5): a file that isn't there yet keeps the code-drawn stand-in. <id>-on / <id>-off for things with two states. The gauge (R5) and the ceiling fan (R2, body and spinning blades) need their measured boxes from the cut before they replace the drawn ones. s08-w5b: the s08b pictures (FV1 lying on the bed, FN1 the fan, TH1 the thermometer): a thing in the room and the same thing in her hands are one picture.

aspect._about: each bed picture's width over its height (drawn at its own shape)

mouth._about: s08-w5b (CLN-175, CLN-105; Zafar 18 Oct: 'the thermometer doesn't sit in her mouth, it's sitting on her bottom lip ... when her face changed ... the thermometer didn't move with it'): TH1's mouth view, its tip (x, y shares of the picture) on her mouth, placed again whenever her face or body picture changes. at = her mouth's middle on each face and body picture (shares of her canvas), measured on the @2x pictures (the dark of the lips and mouth); w = its width as a share of her canvas width; display = its screen (shares of the picture), lit green when the reading is normal at the end

gauge._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R5, the empty gauge; tube = the glass from its top to the bulb's foot (x0, y0, x1, y1 as shares of the picture), bulb = the bulb's width against the tube's. The level and the zones stay code.

tint._about: s08-w5b: a thing on the bed is the same thing she holds or wears: her W10 bottle is teal, so the s08b bottle (red) is turned teal on the bed; her W9 blanket is red, so the bed has the red fleece (items-v2/blanket-red; the s08b blanket is light blue and no filter makes it her red: a flaw for the next art run)

fever-why._src: moved out of the game's code into its data so the engine holds it (step 4e, G26); English placeholder, to record

fever-goal._src: moved out of the game's code into its data so the engine holds it (step 4e, G26); English placeholder, to record
